name: Rep PWA — Full Screen Sweep
description: Login as rep@jawla.test and navigate every PWA screen to verify they load without errors

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/admin/login
On the login page, type 'rep@jawla.test' into the email field and 'password' into the password field, then click the login/submit button
Assert that after login the page redirects to the /app home dashboard and not back to the login page
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app (Home dashboard)
Assert the Home dashboard loads without error and shows dashboard content (not a blank page or 500 error)
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/customers (Today's Customers)
Assert the Customers page loads and shows a customer list or empty state, not a 500 error
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/customers/create (Add Customer)
Assert the Add Customer form loads with input fields for customer name, phone, and address
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/visits (Visits list)
Assert the Visits page loads and shows visit history or an empty state
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/orders (Orders)
Assert the Orders page loads and shows invoice/order history or empty state
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/stock (Stock Search)
Assert the Stock Search page loads with a search input field
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/sell (Sales Flow)
Assert the Sales Flow page loads and shows a customer selection or product search interface
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/collect-payment (Collect Payment)
Assert the Collect Payment page loads with a form for selecting customer and entering payment amount
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/returns (Log Return)
Assert the Returns page loads with a form for selecting customer and adding return items
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/expenses (Log Expense)
Assert the Expenses page loads with a form for expense category, amount, and notes
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/reconcile (Cash Reconcile)
Assert the Cash Reconcile page loads and shows expected balance or a reconciliation form
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/transfers (Van Transfers)
Assert the Van Transfers page loads and shows transfer history or an empty state
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/complaints (Log Complaint)
Assert the Complaints page loads with a form for customer, complaint type, and description
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/quotations (Quotation Flow)
Assert the Quotations page loads and shows quotation requests or an empty state
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/purchase-offer (Submit Purchase Offer)
Assert the Purchase Offer page loads with a form for product, supplier, quantity, and price
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/notifications (Notifications)
Assert the Notifications page loads and shows a notification list or empty state
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/sync-queue (Sync Queue)
Assert the Sync Queue page loads and shows queued operations or an empty state
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/more (More page)
Assert the More page loads and shows additional navigation options
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/profile (Profile)
Assert the Profile page loads and shows user name, email, and editable fields
Navigate to https://jawla-production.up.railway.app/app/settings (Settings)
Assert the Settings page loads and shows user name, company name, and locale info
